definition: The entries below are facts transcribed from official DrivenData/USGS sources or cited staff statements with URLs and retrieval date. This file is not an artifact score receipt. Public leaderboard rows are separately classified PUBLIC-LEADERBOARD-SNAPSHOT; no organizer receipt/hash crosswalk for an artifact in this repository was found.
fetched_by: fetch_page (bash egress cannot reach drivendata.org from this sandbox)

metric.name: Distance-weighted Tversky index (DTI)
metric.kernel: k(d) = max(1 - d/R, 0), R = 300 m = 3 px at 100 m pixels
metric.TP_w: sum over truth pixels g of max over predicted pixels x with d(x,g) <= R of p(x)*k(d)
metric.FP_w: sum over predicted pixels x with p(x) > 0 of p(x) * (1 - max over truth g of k(d))

submission_format.container: single-band GeoTIFF (.tif), or a .zip containing exactly one GeoTIFF
submission_format.reference_writer: https://github.com/drivendataorg/gems-prize-reference-solution (single-band float32, crs/transform from labels, averaged sigmoid in [0,1], no NaN inside the footprint)

masking.statement: Known USGS/INGENIOUS fault pixels are masked out of evaluation in both rounds.
masking.consequence_for_this_lane: A dot placed on the mapped catalogue earns no credit and costs nothing; it is inert. A catalogue margin is therefore a budget choice, not a rule.

aggregation.statement: The public leaderboard is a single pooled index over public-subset pixels; the final round re-evaluates on the whole GeoDAWN area; chunking and subset membership will not be disclosed.
aggregation.consequence_for_this_lane: Every owner-quoted sibling score carries unmodellable chunk luck, so no dot-field statistic can be calibrated against them (measured: best |Spearman| 0.258 over 66 sha256-verified rasters, evidence/live_evidence_fit.json).

label_provenance.statement: The organizers will not disclose how the new test faults were identified; Phase-2 labels are updated by expert review of all Phase-1 submissions.
label_provenance.consequence_for_this_lane: No held-out truth set can be reconstructed locally, and the mandated hide-and-recover holdout can only score catalogue recovery (IR-58-02).

rows.team: further rows on the same page

public_leaderboard_2026_10_11.supersedes: Earlier same-day public-board observation only; not an artifact score.
public_leaderboard_2026_10_11.retrieval_note: Earlier same-day fetch; DARD rank 8. A later observation recorded DARD rank 9; keep the snapshots distinct.
public_leaderboard_2026_10_11.artifact_attribution: NONE; public participant rows only, no artifact hash crosswalk.

prizes_and_rounds.initial_round: top 5 x $10,000 on a fixed private new-fault set
prizes_and_rounds.selection: one submission must be selected for both rounds, blind to private performance

dataset_provenance.surveys: USGS EarthMRI + DOE Office of Geothermal aeromagnetic AND aeroradiometric surveys, plus coordinated 3DEP lidar, over northwestern/western Nevada and eastern California (Walker Lane / western Great Basin)
dataset_provenance.quoted_statement: Most faults in the GeoDAWN region of Nevada are more subtle, and many are hidden below the surface, requiring geophysical data to detect.
dataset_provenance.caveat_quoted_from_page_967: portions of the existing fault data may be misaligned from the true location of the surface fault
literature: Matteo et al. 2021, JGR Solid Earth 126, e2020JB021269, https://doi.org/10.1029/2020JB021269
Hermant, Kiersnowski & Bellanger 2025, Stanford Geothermal Workshop, https://pangea.stanford.edu/ERE/db/GeoConf/papers/SGW/2025/Hermant.pdf
dataset_provenance.irregularity: the delivered 19-band training_features.tif contains no aeroradiometric bands (no eK/eU/eTh/total count) although the About page states they were acquired, and the USGS release is not fetchable from this sandbox (IR-58-DATA-01)

rules.stated_content: participation is subject to https://www.herox.com/GEMSPrize/resource/2274; the page states no submission cap
rules.external_data: external data is allowed if it is publicly available and freely usable, and must be declared (page 967)

not_present_here.organizer_receipt_for_any_file_in_this_r: none; no artifact/hash score crosswalk was found
not_present_here.note: Official source facts and public leaderboard snapshots do not become ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED artifact scores without a receipt/hash crosswalk.
